transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you here today?

Well, I came in because... most days lately, I feel like I’m just sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. It's this heavy, hopeless feeling. And even when I’m around people I know, I just can’t seem to shake it.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been every day, most days, or more off and on?

It's been pretty much every day. For... about a year and two months now. It started ever since I took a fall at an HVAC job I was working. It left me with a back injury, and... well, after that, it just felt like everything started unraveling.
Have you ever had any other periods in your life where you felt this same kind of sadness or hopelessness, before this past year?
No, not really. I mean, I've had normal bad days before, like anyone else. But this heavy feeling... no. I never felt anything like this before the fall.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt completely back to your usual self emotionally, even if just for a few weeks or months, since the fall?
No, I haven't. It's just been a constant... weight, I guess. I haven't felt like myself at all since it happened. Not even for a day.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you used to like?

Yeah, definitely. I used to love doing things like hiking, or painting... even just tinkering around at the makerspace. Honestly, I used to really get a kick out of figuring out a tricky install at work, too. But now, I just... I'll just sit and stare at my supplies. I ignore calls from people. It just feels like none of it is even worth starting anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep? Like trouble falling or staying asleep, or maybe sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, my sleep is all messed up. It's like... I either lie awake for hours, just staring at the ceiling. My back will be hurting from work, and I just can't stop thinking about all the bills I have to pay. Or, on the flip side, I'll end up sleeping for half the day, but when I finally do get up, I still feel completely exhausted, like I didn't get any rest at all.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the last few months, like not feeling hungry or losing weight without trying?

Yeah, my eating is really all over the place. I'll usually go most of the day just on coffee, honestly, because the thought of actual food just turns my stomach. But then... late at night, I'll end up just picking at whatever's in the cabinet. I'm not really even tasting it, just eating it without thinking about it.
Have you ever felt so low or hopeless that you’ve thought about not wanting to live anymore?

Yes, I have. I've been having these thoughts lately that... that everyone would just be better off if I didn't wake up at all. Sometimes, especially when my back is really hurting and the money worries just keep piling up, I actually catch myself thinking about ending it. It scares me that my mind goes there, but... yeah, the thoughts are there.
Have there ever been times in your life when your mood was extremely elevated, or you felt unusually energetic or irritable for several days in a row?

No, I haven't. Honestly, I can't even remember the last time I had any real energy, let alone feeling unusually energetic or... elevated like that. It's pretty much always just the opposite. I'm usually just dragging myself through the day.
Before this current period of feeling down, have you ever had any other times in your life where you felt this level of sadness or hopelessness that lasted for several weeks or more?
No, not really. I mean, I've had rough patches before—everyone does. But I've never felt this heavy, or... or hopeless for weeks on end. This is really the first time it's ever gotten this bad.
Have you had any days at all in the past two years when you felt emotionally stable and like your usual self, or has it been a continuous struggle the whole time?

I don't really know. I mean, the past two years... it hasn't always been this bad, I guess. Like I said, this heavy, hopeless feeling is new. But if you're asking if I've felt completely normal or stable... I'm not sure. It's hard to remember what my usual self even feels like anymore, with the back pain and everything else. It's just been a struggle for a while now.
Before this most recent period of feeling down, have you ever had any other times in your life when your mood was so low that it interfered with your daily life for more than just a few days?

No, I really haven't. Like I mentioned a minute ago, this is the first time I've ever felt this low for this long. I've had normal bad days, sure, but nothing that stopped me from going to work or getting things done around the house. This... this is different. It's the first time it's ever gotten in the way of my life like this.
Before this current episode, have you ever had a time in your life when you felt persistently sad or lost interest in most activities for at least two weeks in a row?

No, I... I really don't think so. I know you keep asking if this has happened before, but it hasn't. I've never had a time where I was just... sad or not wanting to do anything for weeks on end. This is the first time I've ever dealt with anything like this.

Before this current episode, have you ever had a time in your life when you experienced a period of sadness or loss of interest so severe that it lasted for weeks and affected your ability to function, even if it didn’t last as long as this current episode?

I feel like we're going in circles a bit here, but... no. The answer is still no. I've never had a period of time where I felt like this for weeks and couldn't function. Not even once. Until this started, I always just got up, went to work, and did what I needed to do. This is truly the first time anything like this has happened to me.

Have you ever experienced a period of time when your mood was unusually high, you felt extremely confident, or you had so much energy that you didn’t need much sleep, even if it only lasted a few days?

No, definitely not. Um... I've always needed my sleep, especially being on my feet and doing repair work all day. I've never had a time where I felt unusually high or had endless energy like that. Just... normal, everyday energy, at least until all this started.
Can you recall if you’ve ever had any brief periods in your life, even just a few days long, where you felt down or lost interest in things, even before this current episode started?

I mean... no. I know we keep going over this, but no. I've never had anything like that. Just the normal ups and downs everyone gets, but never anything where I felt down or lost interest for days on end. It's just... this is all new. I've never felt this way before.
